response.overview: A drama series that compiles mysterious stories from the dormitory. EPISODE 1 A story about a strange occurrence in an old prayer room at their school. A story about a male student - Imran who is disturbed while praying in the prayer room. EPISODE 2 Adi tells a story about a locker that haunts a new dormitory student named Syaqir. Every night, Syaqir is disturbed by screams and loud knocking from inside the locker. EPISODE 3 Wani shares a story about Aqilah. Unfortunately, Aqilah is found dead and haunts the entire dormitory. Wani sees a mysterious figure inside the warden Farha's house. What happened?
response.title: Cerita Hantu Asrama (Astro Prima)
